desc: Execute a command in a running container
u: docker-exec - Execute a command in a running container

-d, --detach
[=false] Detached mode: run command in the background
--detach-keys
="" Override the key sequence for detaching a container
-e, --env
= Set environment variables
--env-file
= Read in a file of environment variables
-i, --interactive
[=false] Keep STDIN open even if not attached
--privileged
[=false] Give extended privileges to the command
-t, --tty
[=false] Allocate a pseudo-TTY
-u, --user
="" Username or UID (format: "[:]")
-w, --workdir
="" Working directory inside the container
